# Media slots
Drop Lottie animations (.json) or pictures (.png .jpg .webp .svg .gif) here, then list them in `manifest.json`:

    { "transport": "walker.json", "capcom": "capcom.png", "empty": "explore.json" }

| slot | where | suggested size |
|---|---|---|
| `transport` | left end of the walk controls | 96 x 64 |
| `capcom` | next to "Mission plan" | 56 x 56 |
| `empty` | the empty mission list | 240 x 120 |

Unfilled slots show a small dashed placeholder. LottieFiles: https://lottiefiles.com (check each animation's licence).
